change: Replace Shutter with Spin and Expand
behavior: Removed Shutter rendering and its preference option. Spin rotates the wheel into place with a small scale-in (280 ms open / 180 ms close). Expand grows it outward from the anchored center with a soft deceleration (240/160 ms). Fan out and None remain. Segment and label transforms stay synchronized; layout and input geometry remain fixed. The center is painted above moving labels. Effect chips wrap on narrow screens. Saved SHUTTER values load as EXPAND; other saved choices remain unchanged.
test_notes: Seven JVM tests and twenty-two Android UI checks passed. Two animation lifecycle cases were repeated for early/mid frame captures after model-recreation checks cleared the cache; both passed. The final fixture-only capture addition did not change release implementation. Both public references were viewed as temporary contact sheets; no downloaded media is bundled. No new whole-frame performance trace was recorded.
